data.title: 妮姆芙 · 散乱床单上的眼角带泪顺从
data.description: 安静的卧室内，浅蓝睡衬衫纽扣解开，透明小巧的光翼在被单上微颤。被你按在怀里的妮姆芙眼角泛着幸福的泪花，双臂紧紧搂住你的脖子，在喘息中将身心彻底交托给唯一的主人与爱人。
data.location: cozy quiet bedroom with drawn curtains
data.action: pinned on single bed with oversized shirt unbuttoned, delicate translucent wings trembling on sheets, crying happy tears while wrapping arms tightly around partner neck
data.lighting: warm dim bedside lamp glowing softly on porcelain skin and glowing wings
data.mood: profound Angeloid emancipation, deep emotional consummation, sweet trembling surrender
data.promptProse: Pinned on bed with unbuttoned blue shirt, Nymph wraps arms around partner neck with trembling glowing wings and joyful tearful kisses.
data.animaCaption: Nymph with glowing wings and joyful tears embracing partner on bed.
